customers_say: Customers find the lock to be of good quality, with one mentioning it perfectly meets their requirements. The installation process receives positive feedback, with one customer noting that the fitting was done free of cost.

reviews.author: Akash Kumar
reviews.title: Extremely pathetic product & service by Godrej
reviews.body: Extremely pathetic product. It doesn't work properly. Trust me you will buy the product and will regret everyday. You will be left without help from Godrej and might have to break the lock to get in. Please buy some other brand like Native for better product and service. Worst product ever

reviews.title: FIVE STAR
reviews.body: Very good installation done by company , I m very happy best quality of lock

reviews.author: Sandeep Dangi
reviews.title: Good Quality product with prompt free service.
reviews.body: Good product by Godrej and good Service by it's technician. Fast and prompt service. Good Installation. Value for Money. Hopefully should be durable. Fitting was done free of cost although Product page said fitting charges are 499. There was a slight play in the inner handle which technician said is normal for all locks. As for instructions on how to use and set code and finger prints, etc., I suggest use chat gpt as technician can never fully explain everything properly.
